Motivated by
- #20659

Preserve downstream demand and cancellation when tracing an RxJava 1 `Observable`. A bounded request such as `requestMore(1)` must not become an unbounded upstream request, and `unsubscribe()` must reach the source's cleanup.

### Why the Hystrix tests change

`.first()` is valid RxJava usage, but Hystrix 1.4.0 leaks fallback permits on cancellation; broken cancellation propagation had masked that bug. These tests now await completion to work around it. The original tests [passed with the RxJava 1 fix under Hystrix 1.5.18](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/actions/runs/39059007273/job/117473097693), which releases fallback permits on cancellation.
metadata.title: Fix RxJava 1 demand and cancellation propagation
